cases.refreshed: Teens Reach is the youth council for the San José Public Library, providing a key way for young adults to build their leadership skills by developing and participating in library activities, as well as becoming library advisors and advocates. For ages 13-18. Our in-person meet up plans: Teen Volunteer Opportunities; SJPL Teen Programs; Games & Activities; Snacks; Guest Speakers (occasionally). Bring a friend, and learn more about what to expect with volunteering this year. If you are new to volunteering with the San Jose Public Library, please visit the Teens Reach: Community Service webpage: https://www.sjpl.org/teensreach for more information and make sure to create your online volunteer account (click "Sign Me Up" under Joyce Ellington Branch Library) and attend a Joyce Ellington Teens Reach Orientation.

cases.refreshed: Join your community to help your Cambrian Branch Library. Take part in this opportunity to Volunteer Away Your Fines at a rate of $20 per hour. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone who is interested in volunteering away their library fines or gaining service hours for school/work, or who just wants to volunteer. This event will be limited to the first five participants only. Details and Requirements: Must arrive by 4:45 p.m. to sign in at the Information Desk; Must sign a waiver form provided (parents must sign for those under the age of 18); Must be able to commit to the full session (5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m.) No experience or special skills necessary; Training and supplies will be provided. For more information, please call 408-808-3080.

cases.refreshed: Do you want to lead a program at the library? Do you have a passion for science or math, or coding skills you would like to share? Come to our Teen Program Incubator for feedback on how to turn your ideas into an engaging program. Participants will both give and receive feedback and mentorship from other teens and from branch librarians. Interested in being involved with a program but not sure what? We will help connect you with others with similar interests so you can develop a program together. Programs developed at our Incubator may be presented as part of our After-School STEaM series (preferred), or possibly as a standalone program on a Saturday. Participants Must be at least 15-years-old as participation in our Teens Reach volunteer program is required to present a workshop.

cases.refreshed: This is an interactive structured program designed for children ages 5-12 who would like to learn Hindi. Perfectly tailored for learners from all backgrounds whether they hear Hindi at home or are exploring it for the very first time. The curriculum nurtures the four core language skills - Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing aligned with US Academic Standards and the California World Languages Framework. Children will learn through physical workbooks, worksheets and short audio/visual tools provided for the program, ensuring a rich and engaging experience. Children must be accompanied by an adult caregiver during this workshop.

events.title: STEM Wednesdays: Build a Popsicle Stick Catapult

cases.refreshed: Join us to build a catapult out of popsicle sticks, rubber bands, and a plastic spoon. After building the catapult, participants will be given pom-poms to launch. As an added challenge participants can try to launch the pom-poms into a container. Free. Registration not required. Supplies are limited. For youth ages 5 to 10. Parents and caregivers can join their child during the activity.

events.title: Everyone Can Code: Sphero Battle Robots

cases.refreshed: Use Sphero robots to compete in a balloon popping battle. Team up with students to take down your opponents. Learn the basics of Sphero. Learn to roll, aim, control the LEDs, change heading, and detect collisions. Once you have the basics down, you can practice coding through simple, beginner friendly activities.
